title: The plugin ships /sprint, /item and /backlog and a worker agent that run backlog.py from the plugin root against the host project's backlog.json
goal: A project that installs the it-ops-kb plugin and writes a backlog.json gets the skills sprint, item and backlog and the agent worker, each a parameterised copy of the kb's kb-sprint, kb-item, kb-backlog and kb-worker whose commands run python3 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/_tools/backlog.py in the host project, its item files in _backlog/ at the root unless its backlog.json names item_dir; the kb keeps one set of these skills (its own are the plugin's, run with the kb's backlog.json) and no duplicate; the plugin's hooks for horizon --hook and intake are opt-in by a backlog.json key, off by default; plugin.json, README.md and kb/_self/plugin.md say what the plugin now does, within AGENTS.md's 4 KB cap; a kb clone with the plugin not installed still runs its own sprint from .claude/.

gates.question: Once the plugin ships sprint, item and backlog, what happens to the kb's own kb-sprint, kb-item and kb-backlog skills and the kb-worker agent?
options: one set: the kb's skills and agent move to the plugin's skills/ and agents/ directories, parameterised by backlog.json, and .claude/skills/kb-sprint, kb-item, kb-backlog and .claude/agents/kb-worker.md are deleted; the kb runs its sprint through the plugin it installs on itself
two sets: the kb keeps its own skills under .claude/ and the plugin carries copies, both edited on every change
gates.recommendation: one set: the kb's skills and agent move to the plugin's skills/ and agents/ directories, parameterised by backlog.json, and .claude/skills/kb-sprint, kb-item, kb-backlog and .claude/agents/kb-worker.md are deleted; the kb runs its sprint through the plugin it installs on itself

gates.question: What is the default item directory of a project whose backlog.json names none?
options: _backlog/ at the repository root: outside .claude/, so a headless worker can write item files there in default or acceptEdits mode
.claude/backlog/: beside the project's Claude files, protected-path prompts in headless runs accepted
gates.recommendation: _backlog/ at the repository root: outside .claude/, so a headless worker can write item files there in default or acceptEdits mode
gates.answer: _backlog/ at the repository root: outside .claude/, so a headless worker can write item files there in default or acceptEdits mode

gates.question: With one set of the skills and the agent in the plugin, how does a kb clone with the plugin not installed still run its own sprint from .claude/?
options: links: .claude/skills/kb-sprint, kb-item and kb-backlog and .claude/agents/kb-worker.md are relative symlinks to the plugin's skills/sprint, skills/item, skills/backlog and agents/worker.md: one file each, the kb-* names keep working in a clone, a worker's worktree and a plugin-less session
